bonuses.name: Assured Destruction
bonuses.text: Fire Dragons may activate their weapons' Melta trait at Medium and Long Range (as well as Short Range).

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

abilities.name: Battle Focus
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin immediately before or after making a ranged attack to Move up to the Fire Dragon's Speed as a Free Action.

options.name: Fire Dragon Exarch
options.text: A Fire Dragon Exarch has Weapon Skill 9 and 10 Wounds. They lose their Dragon Fusion Gun, and gain the equipment and bonuses below: Firepike: 16 +6 ED / AP -4 / Range 9 - 18 - 27 / Salvo 1 / Assault, Melta; Champion: An Exarch may use Ruin Actions; Burning Heat: Fire Dragons within 10m of their Exarch gain +4 ED on ranged weapon attacks made at Short Range.
